newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers Thurs peak firm power at $18-20/MWh.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers Thurs peak firm power at $18-20/MWh.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered 150 megawatts (MW) of peak firm power for Thursday pre-schedulings at $18.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) and $20.00 for California-Oregon (COB) sales, the agency said Wednesday.
For the previous day, BPA had offered only non-firm power during off-peak hours.
Those offers remained unchanged for Thursday sales at $8.00 for all deliveries during hours ending ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PDT.
Non-firm power at hours ending 0600 and 2300 on Thursday was also unchanged at $10.00, while prices for hours ending 0700-0800 were steady $13.00 per MWh for Northwest sales and $14.00 for COB.
